name: getfacl
description: Prints the access ACL and default ACL for each FILE, including the effective permissions after mask calculation.

options.description: Print all effective rights, including rights masked by the ACL mask.

examples.title: Inspect a file ACL
examples.output:
# file: report.csv
# owner: alice
# group: developers
user::rw-
group::r--
mask::rw-
other::---
examples.explanation: Shows owner, group, named entries, and the ACL mask.

examples.title: Inspect a project tree
examples.output:
# file: project/
# owner: alice
# group: developers
user::rwx
group::r-x
other::---
examples.explanation: Reports ACLs for every item below project.

examples.title: Show effective rights
examples.explanation: Includes effective permissions after the mask is applied.
